onset.Description: Event onset relative to the start of the EDF recording

trial_type.Description: movement/<movement>/<phase>: phases annotated manually from video (descent = onset to hold start, hold = hold start to ascent start, ascent = ascent start to upright). romberg/eyes_open|eyes_closed: from the annotated eye-closure time (TT). instruction/...: instruction display timeline (optical character recognition of the instruction panel). EEG and video clocks were aligned with an offset of 0 s (manual start on a shared count; the residual offset has not been quantified, see README).

repetition.Description: Repetition number of the performed movement (usually 1-4; a participant who performed a different movement than instructed has more repetitions of that movement). Repetitions in which the movement was not performed are not listed.

block.Description: 1 = before, 2 = after the 3-min inter-block standing rest

source.Description: manual = video annotation by the researcher; display = instruction screen

beyond_recording_end.Description: yes = event extends beyond the end of the EEG recording
